status_meanings.query_side_dead: D1 fails: the descriptor moves neither the query nor the attention. Wiring or encoding, not selection.
status_meanings.pathway_unreachable: D3 fails: the value side cannot carry entity identity, so no readout head, sample size or training dose can rescue this read.
status_meanings.conditional_reads_present: D2 clears the 0.40 bar read-only. That contradicts the recorded 0.1125 of trained 10.21.4, so the instrument is suspect first.
status_meanings.selection_bottleneck: D1 and D3 hold while D2 fails: the query carries information and the value path carries the entity, so the missing piece is selection itself.
status_meanings.not_resolved: the stages do not line up into one declared shape, or a reading has no dynamic range.
status_meanings.budget_stop: the declared CPU or wall allowance was exceeded.

limits: Read-only mechanism reading on one synthetic fixture. It produces no output bytes, so it says nothing about P1 (Chinese expression); it trains nothing, so it says nothing about P2. The 10.7 face is excluded because 14.1/14.2 showed the goal equals the correct action sentence there.
